sql:
SELECT z.LocationID, z.Borough, z.Zone, COUNT(t.PULocationID) AS cash_trips
FROM ops.zones z
LEFT JOIN lake.trips t ON t.PULocationID = z.LocationID AND t.payment_type = 2
GROUP BY z.LocationID, z.Borough, z.Zone
ORDER BY z.LocationID

diagnosis.bottleneck: The query scans ~99k trips rows (filtered by payment_type=2), performs a hash join with a CAST on the join key, then aggregates all 99k rows down to 265 zones. The join probe and subsequent hash group-by on the full trips result dominate runtime.
